programs.title: Treehouse Masters
programs.desc: Pete and his gang ride out to the Lone Star State to build a double-decker hideout in Texas Hill Country; Pete creates rustic perfection in six live oak trees with a saloon-style first floor for sippin' sarsaparilla and a glass floor for views below.

programs.title: Expedition Mungo
programs.desc: A massive prehistoric, crocodilian creature known as the Gbahali kills people in Liberia; it may simply be a case of mistaken identity; it could be a super-sized species of crocodile more akin to a dinosaur than anything known today.

programs.title: Expedition Mungo
programs.desc: Mungo travels to Namibia to investigate the Dog-Headed Pig Monster, a creature that prowls through the night, preying on livestock and children. After an adrenaline-filled investigation in the African bush, Mungo captures the night stalker on camera.
